integrity: Two distinct executable exact-arithmetic enumeration programs reproduced 17 classes and 1184 smooth equations; one enumerates all smooth quartic orbits and the other only elation-invariant forms; no external independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic census only over F2 for F2-rational centers and F2-defined fiber-preserving groups; preexisting binary quartic classification and known Klein Galois-point case explicitly excluded from novelty. Potential implicit coverage by older complete automorphism tables.
title: Arithmetic quasi-Galois center profiles of smooth plane quartics over the binary field
